name: Clock and Strings
title: C. Clock and Strings
legend: There is a clock labeled with the numbers 1 through 12 in clockwise order. Alice and Bob have four distinct integers a, b, c, d not more than 12. Alice ties a red string connecting a and b, and Bob ties a blue string connecting c and d. Do the strings intersect? (The strings are straight line segments.)
input_spec: The first line contains t, the number of test cases. Each test case is a line with four distinct integers a, b, c, d (1 <= a, b, c, d <= 12).
output_spec: For each test case, output YES if the strings intersect, and NO otherwise.
note: The Codeforces statement page could not be fetched, so this input was written here and the expected answers are computed geometrically by checker.py.
